items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 19:1
items.html: (To the question) Its phase of from-below-upward is called Guf of Ima, which came out on the coarseness of phase two alone, whose level reaches to Bina, and the Guf expanded in the King of Gevura. And it is the phase of Neshama of ZA. (p. 521, Item 43)
